new_with_entry.brief: Creates a new empty `GtkComboBox` with an entry.
new_with_entry.md:
Creates a new empty `GtkComboBox` with an entry.

In order to use a combo box with entry, you need to tell it
which column of the model contains the text for the entry
by calling [`ComboBox.set_entry_text_column()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#method:set_entry_text_column).

new_with_model.brief: Creates a new `GtkComboBox` with a model.
new_with_model.md: Creates a new `GtkComboBox` with a model.

new_with_model_and_entry.brief: Creates a new empty `GtkComboBox` with an entry and a model.
new_with_model_and_entry.md:
Creates a new empty `GtkComboBox` with an entry and a model.

See also [`ComboBox.new_with_entry()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#constructor:new_with_entry).

doc.brief: A `GtkComboBox` is a widget that allows the user to choose from a list of valid choices.
doc.md:
A `GtkComboBox` is a widget that allows the user to choose from a list of
valid choices.

The `GtkComboBox` displays the selected choice; when activated, the
`GtkComboBox` displays a popup which allows the user to make a new choice.

The `GtkComboBox` uses the model-view pattern; the list of valid choices
is specified in the form of a tree model, and the display of the choices
can be adapted to the data in the model by using cell renderers, as you
would in a tree view. This is possible since `GtkComboBox` implements the
[`CellLayout`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CellLayout) interface. The tree model holding the valid
choices is not restricted to a flat list, it can be a real tree, and the
popup will reflect the tree structure.

To allow the user to enter values not in the model, the
[`ComboBox:has-entry`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#property:has-entry) property allows the `GtkComboBox` to
contain a [`Entry`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Entry). This entry can be accessed by calling
[`ComboBox.get_child()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#method:get_child) on the combo box.

For a simple list of textual choices, the model-view API of `GtkComboBox`
can be a bit overwhelming. In this case, [`ComboBoxText`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBoxText) offers
a simple alternative. Both `GtkComboBox` and `GtkComboBoxText` can contain
an entry.

## CSS nodes

```
combobox
├── box.linked
│   ╰── button.combo
│       ╰── box
│           ├── cellview
│           ╰── arrow
╰── window.popup
```

A normal combobox contains a box with the .linked class, a button
with the .combo class and inside those buttons, there are a cellview and
an arrow.

```
combobox
├── box.linked
│   ├── entry.combo
│   ╰── button.combo
│       ╰── box
│           ╰── arrow
╰── window.popup
```

A `GtkComboBox` with an entry has a single CSS node with name combobox.
It contains a box with the .linked class. That box contains an entry and
a button, both with the .combo class added. The button also contains another
node with name arrow.

## Accessibility

`GtkComboBox` uses the [`AccessibleRole.combo_box`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:combo_box) role.

get_active.brief: Returns the index of the currently active item.
get_active.md:
Returns the index of the currently active item.

If the model is a non-flat treemodel, and the active item is not
an immediate child of the root of the tree, this function returns
`gtk_tree_path_get_indices (path)[0]`, where `path` is the
[`TreePath`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TreePath) of the active item.

get_active_id.brief: Returns the ID of the active row of `combo_box`.
get_active_id.md:
Returns the ID of the active row of `combo_box`.

This value is taken from the active row and the column specified
by the [`ComboBox:id-column`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#property:id-column) property of `combo_box`
(see [`ComboBox.set_id_column()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#method:set_id_column)).

The returned value is an interned string which means that you can
compare the pointer by value to other interned strings and that you
must not free it.

If the [`ComboBox:id-column`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#property:id-column) property of `combo_box` is
not set, or if no row is active, or if the active row has a `NULL`
ID value, then `NULL` is returned.

get_active_iter.brief: Sets `iter` to point to the currently active item.
get_active_iter.md:
Sets `iter` to point to the currently active item.

If no item is active, `iter` is left unchanged.

get_button_sensitivity.brief: Returns whether the combo box sets the dropdown button sensitive or not when there are no items in the model.
get_button_sensitivity.md:
Returns whether the combo box sets the dropdown button
sensitive or not when there are no items in the model.

get_entry_text_column.brief: Returns the column which `combo_box` is using to get the strings from to display in the internal entry.
get_entry_text_column.md:
Returns the column which `combo_box` is using to get the strings
from to display in the internal entry.

get_has_entry.brief: Returns whether the combo box has an entry.
get_has_entry.md: Returns whether the combo box has an entry.

get_id_column.brief: Returns the column which `combo_box` is using to get string IDs for values from.
get_id_column.md:
Returns the column which `combo_box` is using to get string IDs
for values from.

get_popup_fixed_width.brief: Gets whether the popup uses a fixed width.
get_popup_fixed_width.md: Gets whether the popup uses a fixed width.

get_row_separator_func.brief: Returns the current row separator function.
get_row_separator_func.md: Returns the current row separator function.

popdown.brief: Hides the menu or dropdown list of `combo_box`.

popup.brief: Pops up the menu or dropdown list of `combo_box`.
popup.md:
Pops up the menu or dropdown list of `combo_box`.

This function is mostly intended for use by accessibility technologies;
applications should have little use for it.

Before calling this, `combo_box` must be mapped, or nothing will happen.

popup_for_device.md:
Pops up the menu of `combo_box`.

Note that currently this does not do anything with the device, as it was
previously only used for list-mode combo boxes, and those were removed
in GTK 4. However, it is retained in case similar functionality is added
back later.

set_active.brief: Sets the active item of `combo_box` to be the item at `index`.
set_active.md: Sets the active item of `combo_box` to be the item at `index`.

set_active_id.brief: Changes the active row of `combo_box` to the one that has an ID equal to `active_id`.
set_active_id.md:
Changes the active row of `combo_box` to the one that has an ID equal to
`active_id`.

If `active_id` is `NULL`, the active row is unset. Rows having
a `NULL` ID string cannot be made active by this function.

If the [`ComboBox:id-column`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#property:id-column) property of `combo_box` is
unset or if no row has the given ID then the function does nothing
and returns `FALSE`.

set_active_iter.brief: Sets the current active item to be the one referenced by `iter`.
set_active_iter.md:
Sets the current active item to be the one referenced by `iter`.

If `iter` is `NULL`, the active item is unset.

set_button_sensitivity.brief: Sets whether the dropdown button of the combo box should update its sensitivity depending on the model contents.
set_button_sensitivity.md:
Sets whether the dropdown button of the combo box should update
its sensitivity depending on the model contents.

set_entry_text_column.brief: Sets the model column which `combo_box` should use to get strings from to be `text_column`.
set_entry_text_column.md:
Sets the model column which `combo_box` should use to get strings
from to be `text_column`.

For this column no separate
[`CellRenderer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CellRenderer) is needed.

The column `text_column` in the model of `combo_box` must be of
type %G_TYPE_STRING.

This is only relevant if `combo_box` has been created with
[`ComboBox:has-entry`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#property:has-entry) as `TRUE`.

set_id_column.brief: Sets the model column which `combo_box` should use to get string IDs for values from.
set_id_column.md:
Sets the model column which `combo_box` should use to get string IDs
for values from.

The column `id_column` in the model of `combo_box` must be of type
%G_TYPE_STRING.

set_model.brief: Sets the model used by `combo_box` to be `model`.
set_model.md:
Sets the model used by `combo_box` to be `model`.

Will unset a previously set model (if applicable). If model is `NULL`,
then it will unset the model.

Note that this function does not clear the cell renderers, you have to
call [`CellLayout.clear()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.CellLayout#method:clear) yourself if you need to set up different
cell renderers for the new model.

set_popup_fixed_width.brief: Specifies whether the popup’s width should be a fixed width.
set_popup_fixed_width.md:
Specifies whether the popup’s width should be a fixed width.

If `fixed` is `TRUE`, the popup's width is set to match the
allocated width of the combo box.

set_row_separator_func.brief: Sets the row separator function, which is used to determine whether a row should be drawn as a separator.
set_row_separator_func.md:
Sets the row separator function, which is used to determine
whether a row should be drawn as a separator.

If the row separator function is `NULL`, no separators are drawn.
This is the default value.

active.brief: The item which is currently active.
active.md:
The item which is currently active.

If the model is a non-flat treemodel, and the active item is not an
immediate child of the root of the tree, this property has the value
`gtk_tree_path_get_indices (path)[0]`, where `path` is the
[`TreePath`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TreePath) of the active item.

active-id.brief: The value of the ID column of the active row.
active-id.md: The value of the ID column of the active row.

button-sensitivity.brief: Whether the dropdown button is sensitive when the model is empty.
button-sensitivity.md:
Whether the dropdown button is sensitive when
the model is empty.

entry-text-column.brief: The model column to associate with strings from the entry.
entry-text-column.md:
The model column to associate with strings from the entry.

This is property only relevant if the combo was created with
[`ComboBox:has-entry`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#property:has-entry) is `TRUE`.

has-entry.brief: Whether the combo box has an entry.
has-entry.md: Whether the combo box has an entry.

has-frame.brief: The `has-frame` property controls whether a frame is drawn around the entry.
has-frame.md: The `has-frame` property controls whether a frame is drawn around the entry.

id-column.brief: The model column that provides string IDs for the values in the model, if != -1.
id-column.md:
The model column that provides string IDs for the values
in the model, if != -1.

model.brief: The model from which the combo box takes its values.
model.md: The model from which the combo box takes its values.

popup-fixed-width.brief: Whether the popup's width should be a fixed width matching the allocated width of the combo box.
popup-fixed-width.md:
Whether the popup's width should be a fixed width matching the
allocated width of the combo box.

popup-shown.brief: Whether the combo boxes dropdown is popped up.
popup-shown.md:
Whether the combo boxes dropdown is popped up.

Note that this property is mainly useful, because
it allows you to connect to notify::popup-shown.

activate.brief: Emitted to when the combo box is activated.
activate.md:
Emitted to when the combo box is activated.

The `::activate` signal on `GtkComboBox` is an action signal and
emitting it causes the combo box to pop up its dropdown.

changed.brief: Emitted when the active item is changed.
changed.md:
Emitted when the active item is changed.

The can be due to the user selecting a different item from the list,
or due to a call to [`ComboBox.set_active_iter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ComboBox#method:set_active_iter). It will
also be emitted while typing into the entry of a combo box with an entry.

format-entry-text.brief: Emitted to allow changing how the text in a combo box's entry is displayed.

move-active.brief: Emitted to move the active selection.
move-active.md:
Emitted to move the active selection.

This is an [keybinding signal](class.SignalAction.html).

popdown.brief: Emitted to popdown the combo box list.
popdown.md:
Emitted to popdown the combo box list.

This is an [keybinding signal](class.SignalAction.html).

The default bindings for this signal are Alt+Up and Escape.

popup.brief: Emitted to popup the combo box list.
popup.md:
Emitted to popup the combo box list.

This is an [keybinding signal](class.SignalAction.html).

The default binding for this signal is Alt+Down.

changed.brief: Signal is emitted when the active item is changed.
changed.md: Signal is emitted when the active item is changed.

format_entry_text.brief: Signal which allows you to change how the text displayed in a combo box’s entry is displayed.
format_entry_text.md:
Signal which allows you to change how the text
   displayed in a combo box’s entry is displayed.
